title: 2024 Topps Series 2 #SMLB-41 Christian Yelich Milwaukee Brewers Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2024 Topps Series 2 trading card features Milwaukee Brewers player Christian Yelich in the Stars Of MLB insert set. The card is made of 35 pt. card stock and is an original licensed reprint. It has a card number of SMLB-41 and was manufactured by Topps in the United States. The card is a standard size and is part of the Major League Baseball (MLB) league. It is a sports trading card and is in English language. The card is not autographed and is not vintage.
